The following functions in `profiling_sandbox/requests/auth.py` now have one-line docstrings added:

1. `AuthBase.__call__`: Base class that all auth implementations derive from.
2. `HTTPBasicAuth.__call__`: Attaches HTTP Basic Authentication to the given Request object.
3. `HTTPProxyAuth.__call__`: Attaches HTTP Proxy Authentication to a given Request object.
4. `HTTPDigestAuth.build_digest_header`: Builds the Digest Authentication header for a request.
5. `HTTPDigestAuth.handle_redirect`: Resets the 401 call counter on redirects.
6. `HTTPDigestAuth.handle_401`: Handles 401 Unauthorized responses by attempting digest authentication.
7. `HTTPDigestAuth.__call__`: Initializes per-thread state and handles digest authentication for a request.

These docstrings have been added without changing any behavior of the functions.
